memory_candidates.content: In a position-labelled branching certificate, any coherence clause that quantifies over the one-step reach of a position forces its right-hand side constant on that reach; if the reach is a whole share-class (at either time), labels collapse. Succession must be free data (a relation), not derivable from the state equivalence, and any bounded-window encoding collapses one step beyond the window.

With a free succession relation, 'every frame history is a thread' needs a closure condition; index-level splice conditions are either collapses or unsatisfiable by sound presentations. The exact condition is path lifting, proved from finite-segment lifting by IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_sequence_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed on (ℤ → Fin n); splice-closed lassos give a cheap sufficient case via Finite.exists_infinite_fiber.
